description_en: Queries the content understanding and creative script generation task
description_zh: 查询内容理解与创意脚本生成任务
name: GetVideoRemakeJob

parameters.help_en: The job ID returned by SubmitVideoRemakeJob
parameters.name: job_id

Job.description_en: The details of the unified remake job

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code for the failed asynchronous task. This parameter has a value only when a fault occurs and the status is Failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 异步任务失败的错误码，Failed 时有值

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for the failed asynchronous task. This parameter has a value only when a fault occurs and the status is Failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 异步任务失败的错误信息，Failed 时有值

JobId.description_en: The ID of the unified remake job

JobResult.description_en: The content understanding and script outputs returned when the job status is Finished. This does not include the rendered video
JobResult.description_zh: Finished 时返回的内容理解和脚本产物，不是渲染成片

AiResult.description_en: The download URL of the JSON file for the content understanding result
AiResult.description_zh: 内容理解结果 JSON 文件的下载地址

Script.description_en: The download URL of the creative script JSON file. Use the file content as the Script parameter for SubmitVideoRenderJob
Script.description_zh: 创意脚本 JSON 文件下载地址。使用文件内容作为 SubmitVideoRenderJob 的 Script 参数

MediaIds.description_en: The list of input media asset IDs
MediaIds.description_zh: 输入媒资 ID 列表

items.description_en: The ID of the input media asset. If the input is a URL, the registered media asset ID is returned
items.description_zh: 输入媒资的 ID；如果输入是 URL，返回注册后的媒资 ID

MediaIds.title_en: 输入媒资 ID 列表
MediaIds.title_zh: 输入媒资 ID 列表

Status.description_en: The job status. Valid values: Created, Executing, Finished, and Failed. Finished indicates that content understanding and script generation are complete. If the status is Failed, check ErrorCode and ErrorMessage. If the job has been deleted, the query returns RecordNotFound
Status.description_zh: 任务状态：Created / Executing / Finished / Failed。Finished 表示内容理解和脚本生成完成，Failed 时查看 ErrorCode 和 ErrorMessage。任务已删除时，查询返回 RecordNotFound

UserData.description_en: The UserData JSON string specified during submission. The value is returned as is
UserData.description_zh: 提交时的 UserData JSON 字符串，原样返回
